data.name: Squares Proximity
data.detailed_description:
Squares Proximity is a deceptively simple, yet endlessly deep single-player strategy game. Every turn is a puzzle of risk and reward. Your goal is to dominate the grid by making smart, precise placements.

The rules are easy to learn: place your numbered squares to buff your own territory and capture your opponents. But as the board fills up, every decision becomes critical. Will you strengthen your position or launch an attack? It's all about outthinking the AI in a pure test of tactical skill. 🧠

Key Features

⚔️ Intense Tactical Duels: Face off 1v1 or escalate the chaos with up to four-player 1v1v1v1 matches on a single, clean grid.

🤖 Cunning AI Opponents: Challenge 1, 2, or 3 capable AI rivals that think ahead, prioritize high-value captures, and won't give up without a fight.

🔢 Simple Core Gameplay: Receive a shuffled sequence of numbered squares. Place them on any empty cell to influence the board. Every placement counts!

🔼 Power Up Your Tiles: Place a square next to your own to give every adjacent friendly tile a +1 boost. Create powerful clusters to fortify your position!

💥 Smart & Strategic Captures: Place your square next to an opponent's. If your number is higher than an adjacent enemy tile, you capture it and make it yours!

🏆 Every Point Matters: Your final score is the total sum of all numbers on the tiles you control. Small captures can lead to big victories!

🎨 Clean, Bold Visuals: With a high-contrast, minimalist design, you can read the entire state of the game at a glance, no matter how complex the board gets.

🔄 Endless Replayability: Thanks to shuffled tile orders and unpredictable AI, no two matches are ever the same. A fresh challenge awaits you every time you play.
